regressionTests.kind: synthetic mechanics checks, no campaign seed replay

mechanics: Do not consume a terminal waypoint until the actor is actually inside its attack envelope.
Refine a failed coarse route to find narrow legal approaches; keep collision extents unchanged and reject blocked goal centres.
Release dead opening anchors so delayed units can acquire living enemies.
Reverse unengaged scenario patrols at their endpoint and preserve combat suspension.

patrolReference.title: Age of Empires II: The Age of Kings manual
patrolReference.quote: The unit will patrol back and forth from its starting point to the patrol point you select.

limitations: Synthetic tests and saved-state diagnosis establish engine behavior, not full live-game fidelity.
Old completed native seeds remain at their original engine versions. Combined seed reviews must disclose this.
publication: local only; pre-push guard retained; production unchanged
